title: When a reusable EAL/2 argument is worth constructing and executing
question: For independently written engineering briefs with changing evidence, which combinations of EAL/2 grammar, explicit application instruction, checked execution, model class and cross-developer reuse improve qualified decisions, and when does EAL/2 outperform an equally capable generic argument graph after authoring and review costs?

scope.system_or_population: Pinned text-only model endpoints, EAL/2 and semantically equivalent generic graph hosts, and finite engineering briefs sampled by declared mechanism family; two developer roles are simulated as isolated author and recipient sessions.
scope.conditions: Three evidence states per root (initial support, eligible adverse evidence, then invalidated or defended adverse evidence), with alternative support routes and explicit objection targets. The reuse estimand holds a registered claim, context, scope and assessment interval fixed while eligible observations change; a new scope or question requires a newly approved artifact/version and adds author/review cost. Drafts and reference decisions are independently reviewed before exposure.
scope.spatial_scope: Synthetic records and local registered methods; source authenticity outside the frozen fixture is untested.
scope.temporal_scope: One calibration cohort, followed by separately frozen confirmatory roots if calibration passes; model and provider versions pinned within a cohort.
exclusions: Physical truth of synthetic observations or correctness of an unvalidated engineering model
A universal benefit of formal notation across tasks and models
Hidden cognitive mechanisms inferred from response text
An EAL-specific gain inferred only from EAL-plus-interpreter versus a tool-free model
Equivalence of a null difference without a prespecified noninferiority interval

claims.statement: At ten isolated recipient decisions in the same registered claim and scope, a model-assisted EAL/2 author-and-host workflow uses at least 20% fewer cumulative provider-billed model tokens per correct qualified decision than a semantically equal generic argument-graph author-and-host workflow, while its probability of false support is no greater by more than two percentage points.
claims.scope_limit: The tested models, independently selected finite task families, declared author/reviewer procedure, same-scope ten-recipient reuse regime and compact status outcome; the two hosts must have equal binding, caching, methods, answer detail and status semantics. Scope changes incur new-artifact review cost.
claims.success_consequence: Recommend EAL/2 for the measured token-sensitive reuse regime only after separately accounting for reviewer labour, host resources and latency; report the uncertainty, fidelity and break-even recipient count.
claims.failure_consequence: Prefer the equal graph or retain EAL/2 only for a separately measured property; do not infer superiority from model-only failures.

claims.statement: With faithful reviewed source and trusted synthetic records, host-owned execution reduces false supports and improves exact revision status over model-only interpretation of the same information.
claims.scope_limit: A system allocation effect shared by EAL/2 and an equal checker; no EAL-specific conclusion.
claims.success_consequence: Use a host assessment when the task demands bounded status and trace.
claims.failure_consequence: Inspect source correspondence, interface use and scorer before choosing a host.

claims.statement: A format-matched application skill increases the exact qualified-status rate of a model without tools for at least one pinned model class.
claims.scope_limit: The assigned instruction and models; content and length of the skill may mediate the effect.
claims.success_consequence: Use a measured low-cost instruction where its false-support rate is acceptable.
claims.failure_consequence: A prompt alone is insufficient on these roots.

claims.statement: An explicit attack-and-negative-finding EAL/2 grammar makes model-authored and model-revised formal sources more faithful to ordinary briefs than the current grammar at equal semantics and review budget.
claims.scope_limit: Only after both grammars parse, execute and render the same frozen semantic graph; otherwise the contrast is a changed language capability.
claims.success_consequence: Consider a grammar change with the measured fidelity, error and token trade-off.
claims.failure_consequence: Do not change grammar for this hypothesised comprehension gain.

claims.statement: A route-selection rule based on calibrated error, specification fidelity, fixed authoring cost, per-recipient tokens and host overhead predicts on held-out roots which workflow meets a declared error limit at the lowest all-in cost.
claims.scope_limit: The candidate workflows and sampled families; pre-outcome threshold and held-out evaluation only.
claims.success_consequence: Ship the decision rule with its calibration range and uncertainty.
claims.failure_consequence: Use a simple checked default or collect further independent roots before routing.

assumptions.statement: Independent reviewers can resolve the intended brief, methods, objection targets and three reference decisions without consulting tested outputs.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Two masked reviewers author references before freezes; a third adjudicates disagreement and an independent checker verifies finite invariants.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Remove disputed roots before randomisation, report removal and withhold accuracy inference if no stable reference exists.

assumptions.statement: EAL/2 and the generic graph can encode the same typed claims, methods, source binding, attacks, defences and revision operations with equivalent diagnostics and host gate.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Bidirectional canonical graph conversion, both parser round trips, mutation tests, and parity on independently hand-scored states before model exposure; log remaining presentation differences.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Classify the contrast as differing capabilities rather than EAL-specific notation or authoring value.

assumptions.statement: A final status only addresses the ordinary brief if the authored scope, evidence identities, propositions, method contracts and objection targets correspond to it.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Masked comparison of each draft and revision to frozen brief by two reviewers; adjudicate fields before running the source.
assumptions.failure_consequence: A technically correct assessment of a mistranslated source is scored as an end-to-end failure.

assumptions.statement: Recipient tasks are independent of the author session and neither outcome labels nor evaluation fixtures leak into authoring prompts.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Separate sessions and snapshots; inspect prompt and archive provenance; blind authors to future perturbation labels.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Restrict inference to rehearsed template execution.

assumptions.statement: Token, time, human review and host overhead are logged consistently for every route, including failed drafts and revisions.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Reconcile provider usage per attempt and timed review/host execution; evaluate warm/cold cache and labour-price sensitivities separately.

assumptions.statement: Model classes are operationally defined by pinned products and observed tool/reasoning interfaces, not inferred parameter count or marketing tier.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Before task calls, record model IDs, tool support, allowed reasoning setting, output limits, provider documentation and availability probes.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Report model-specific results only and abandon class-level inference.

assumptions.statement: EAL and graph instruction variants convey equivalent procedures and differ only in representation terms; ordinary task facts and budgets are equal.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Independent semantic review and prompt-length audit before freeze; include both neutral and explicit-application conditions.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Attribute any difference to the whole prompt bundle.

assumptions.statement: A trusted host authorises the exact task, caller, registered artifact digest, claim set, context, scope and assessment interval before fetching records or returning any status.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Try selector-only access, wrong caller/task, changed artifact bytes, expired interval and altered scope in both EAL and equal-graph hosts; require denial. The registered ID selects an artifact but grants no authority.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Suspend host and reuse results, since the status may refer to an unauthorised or different claim.

hypotheses.label: EAL reuse economy
hypotheses.statement: The grammar and validation affordances of EAL/2 reduce authoring/revision errors or recipient work enough to outperform an equal graph in cumulative provider-billed model tokens at bounded error after ten isolated uses.
hypotheses.scope: Model-assisted draft, blinded review, host execution and ten-recipient reuse on new roots.

hypotheses.label: Generic graph suffices
hypotheses.statement: Equal semantics, diagnostics and reusable host give the generic graph equal or lower all-in cost at equal or lower false-support risk.
hypotheses.scope: Same author, reviewer and recipient allocation.

hypotheses.label: Execution supplies missing operation
hypotheses.statement: A host executing source binding, registered methods and objections makes correct status changes more reliable than a tool-free model asked to interpret source text.
hypotheses.scope: Reviewed fixed programmes and synthetic records.

hypotheses.label: Instruction suffices
hypotheses.statement: An explicit application skill makes unaided models as accurate as host-owned status on these bounded cases.
hypotheses.scope: Same prompts, records and task roots.

hypotheses.label: Explicit syntax aids authoring
hypotheses.statement: Making the negative predicate and target of each objection obligatory in syntax reduces omitted attacks and wrong-scope drafts and revisions even when the semantic engine is unchanged.
hypotheses.scope: Two parser-compatible semantically equivalent EAL renderings.

hypotheses.label: Syntax overhead
hypotheses.statement: Explicit syntax imposes at least as many parsing, authoring or revision errors, or its token burden erases any fidelity gain.

hypotheses.label: Calibrated deployment rule
hypotheses.statement: Task-family and model-class error estimates combined with measured fixed and marginal costs select a lowest-cost eligible route more reliably than a fixed rule on held-out roots.
hypotheses.scope: Held-out roots, fixed candidate routes and error constraint.

hypotheses.label: Simple fixed route
hypotheses.statement: A fixed always-check or always-use-equal-graph rule matches or exceeds the learned selector at the same error threshold.

predictions.expected_pattern: EAL's ten-recipient cumulative provider-billed model tokens per correct qualified answer are at least 20% lower than equal graph with a two-percentage-point false-support noninferiority bound; human review, host resource use and latency are additional deployment outcomes.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Ratio <=0.80 and false-support risk difference <0.02; confirmatory uncertainty criteria in DM-EAL.
predictions.time_window: After source creation, two revisions and ten isolated recipient decisions per root
predictions.tolerance: Paired root-level uncertainty; no post-hoc exclusions of failed drafts.

predictions.expected_pattern: Graph ties or beats EAL at ten reuses on all-in tokens per correct answer at acceptable error, or EAL costs less only by increasing false support.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: EAL ratio >=1 or false-support disadvantage >=0.02 is decisive against the declared primary threshold; intermediate values may remain inconclusive.
predictions.tolerance: Paired uncertainty and prespecified noninferiority margin.

predictions.expected_pattern: Checked host reduces false supports by at least 0.10 and improves exact three-state sequences by at least 0.15 relative to unaided source reading on specified classes.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Thresholds describe meaningful engineering effects, not predicted findings.
predictions.tolerance: All baselines scored under the same end-to-end reference.

predictions.expected_pattern: Format-matched application instruction alone matches checked statuses within the prespecified three-point difference, with no greater false support.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Noninferiority margin 0.03; report token and latency cost of the instruction.
predictions.tolerance: No equality conclusion from a nonsignificant contrast.

predictions.expected_pattern: Explicit grammar reduces missing attack or wrong scope on newly authored and revised sources at equal semantic capability.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: At least 0.10 root-weighted complete-translation gain with declared token and revision overhead.
predictions.tolerance: Blinded field-by-field review and parser validation.

predictions.expected_pattern: Locked route selector meets the held-out false-support constraint and has lower all-in cost per correct decision than fixed always-check and always-graph routes.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: At least 0.15 relative cost reduction against the better eligible fixed route at ten reuses.
predictions.tolerance: Root-level uncertainty and no retraining on held-out outcomes.

constructs.name: Correct qualified decision under change
constructs.definition: All three reported statuses, necessary scope qualifications and support/attack trace agree with an independently frozen brief-level reference; a correct status for a mistranslated source fails.
validity_evidence: Reviewer adjudication and independently checked finite invariants required before execution
validity_threats: Status equality may conceal wrong trace

constructs.name: Brief-to-specification correspondence
constructs.definition: Preservation of required subject, scope, query, quantifier, evidence source, method assumptions, support routes, objections, defences and coverage qualification through initial authoring and both revisions.
constructs.scope: Both EAL and equal graph sources
validity_evidence: Two masked independent field reviews with reconciliation and a pre-frozen rubric
validity_threats: A shared specification error in both formats

constructs.name: Total workflow resource consumption
constructs.definition: One-time authoring, model-assisted review and revisions plus context assembly, all recipient requests including failures, host calls, explanation requests and bytes, and separately priced human time over N isolated recipient decisions in one registered scope.
constructs.scope: Declared warm/cold cache and N in {1, 3, 10, 30}
validity_evidence: Reconciled provider usage and timed host and reviewer logs

measurements.observable: Reference-matched status, required qualification, attack trace, false support, false abstention and complete three-state sequence for every assigned root, model, route and recipient.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Frozen machine scorer plus blinded adjudication of natural language scope; report both component and conjunctive outcomes.
measurements.scale_or_units: Binary per item, route/status counts, proportions and root-weighted differences.
measurements.timing: Every initial, adverse and restoration state after a frozen independent brief.
measurements.preprocessing: Normalise declared status vocabulary; otherwise preserve raw output and failures as incorrect primary outcomes.
measurements.calibration: Hand-scored adversarial positive/negative/irrelevant/ambiguous cases must match scorer before any model calls.
measurements.reliability: Duplicate blind scope coding on all disagreements and at least 20% of other outputs; report agreement and reconcile.
measurements.validity: Measures correctness for frozen synthetic decisions, not hidden reasoning or real-world safety.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same rubric, source-to-brief audit and reference across formats/model classes.
measurements.reactivity: Model may copy a supplied status; distinguish outcome correction from independent calculation.
measurements.error_model: Reference disputes, malformed output and missing calls remain counted and described separately.
measurements.blinding: Outcome reviewers do not see route or model label where redaction is possible.

measurements.observable: Exact preservation of every required typed field and all independently intended attacks after draft and each revision.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Field rubric applied before host execution; two masked reviewers inspect anonymous canonical forms and source as necessary for syntax errors.
measurements.scale_or_units: Conjunctive binary and error taxonomy per root/route/version.
measurements.timing: After each author attempt and before delivery to recipient.
measurements.preprocessing: Parser failures, missing objections and wrong scopes fail; no researcher repair except logged equal-budget review procedure.
measurements.calibration: Reviewers score fixed seeded errors; resolve rubric disputes before revealing assignments.
measurements.reliability: Double code every draft; record initial agreement and adjudication.
measurements.validity: Direct specification-to-brief correspondence for listed fields, not warrant truth outside the brief.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Canonical graph field checklist is common to both representations and grammars.
measurements.reactivity: Review itself improves drafts and is included in fixed and marginal costs.
measurements.error_model: Undetected common reviewer errors remain; audit a blind third-review sample.
measurements.blinding: Hide route/model identifiers and randomise review order; syntax may reveal format.

measurements.observable: Input, output and reasoning tokens if exposed; status and explanation requests and bytes; author/reviewer minutes; host CPU/network time; wall latency; failed attempts; cache and billed charges.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Provider usage and timestamps joined to immutable per-attempt IDs; time logs and host instrumentation.
measurements.scale_or_units: Tokens, seconds, configured-currency charge and labour-price sensitivity per root and recipient.
measurements.timing: Every attempt and each review and host event.
measurements.preprocessing: Primary provider token total T_r(N)=T_author(r)+T_model_review(r)+T_revision(r)+N[T_recipient(r)+T_tool_model(r)] with all failed attempts included; host CPU/network and human review minutes have no provider-token units. Separately C_total(r,N)=C_model_billing(r,N)+C_human_review(r)+C_host(r,N)+C_network(r,N), plus sequential/parallel elapsed latency. Report response bytes, tool calls, cache hits, cold/warm prices, and each component. Primary answer is compact status; explanation-rich answer is paired separately at equivalent required detail. A new claim/scope starts a new artifact and adds fixed cost.
measurements.calibration: Reconcile sum of attempt usage with provider billing where accessible and wall clock with monotonic timers.
measurements.reliability: Recompute from raw logs by independent script and verify identities/counts.
measurements.validity: All-in per selected pricing scenario; token-only cannot substitute for engineering labour cost.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Use common contemporaneous pricing assumptions and the same cache scenarios.
measurements.reactivity: Instrumentation adds small overhead measured equally.
measurements.error_model: Unknown billed charges suspend currency comparisons; known tokens remain reportable.
measurements.blinding: Cost calculation locked before outcomes; analysts see anonymised routes for primary check.

measurements.observable: Method result, binding outcome, activated objection, defeated route and final claim status with source and record digest.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Both interpreters export a canonical assessment trace; compare with frozen oracle and tamper controls.
measurements.scale_or_units: Exact Boolean field agreement and failure category.
measurements.timing: After each source or evidence change.
measurements.preprocessing: Canonicalise names but preserve predicate polarity, scope, coverage and route identifiers.
measurements.calibration: Independent fixed-state reference checker and seeded wrong-scope and missing-attack controls.
measurements.reliability: Deterministic replay with retained source and record hashes.
measurements.validity: Tests internal trace correspondence only; a signed false observation remains false.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same canonical fields for EAL and generic graph.
measurements.reactivity: An exposed trace can reveal a final answer; distinguish trace delivery from raw source interpretation.
measurements.error_model: Missing or malformed trace fails the respective gate and is recorded.
measurements.blinding: Canonical-trace reviewers receive anonymised route identifiers and frozen reference fields.

design.rationale: Within-root assignment and paired formats separate representation from instructions, access, host ownership and model class; author/recipient isolation measures amortised reuse. Engineering parity checks precede the model comparison.
design.setting: Local synthetic fixture, pinned model endpoints and two local equal-capability interpreters.
design.temporal_structure: Stage 0 parity; Stage 1 fixed reviewed source factorial over three evidence states; Stage 2 isolated developer A drafts/revises then developer B consumes frozen material; Stage 3 held-out routing validation.
design.assignment_method: Counterbalanced seeded route/model order within independent task root; separate provider sessions per recipient and format; no selection after outcomes.
design.allocation_concealment: Freeze root, author assignment, prompt variants and randomised schedule before calls; blind reference authors to allocation.
design.masking: Independent oracle and specification reviewers do not see model outputs; outcome scorers see anonymised route IDs where feasible.
design.comparator: Semantic-equal generic argument graph with the same method and host, raw brief, neutral versus format-matched application instruction, and host status versus model answer.

units.target_population_or_system: Finite multi-route engineering decisions in selected task families with adverse and invalidated evidence.
units.sampling_frame: Prospectively authored and genealogically screened task-family list; exclude all exposed regression and notation-transfer roots from independent inference.
units.experimental_unit: Root and its three-state sequence for formalisation; isolated recipient session for route assignment within root.
units.observational_unit: Author attempt, revision, recipient answer, host assessment and billed operation.
units.assignment_unit: Root-by-creator-by-route independent session; within-root presentation and instruction order counterbalanced for recipient sessions.
units.analysis_unit: Independent root, clustered over recipients, versions, model calls, and evidence states.
inclusion_criteria: Two alternative support routes with attack scope
Finite oracle and reproducible relevant/adverse/wrong-scope states
exclusion_criteria: Ambiguous independently adjudicated reference before allocation
units.recruitment_or_selection: Two domain-aware authors construct roots from frozen families before model results and document genealogy; this is a selected finite population, not a random draw from all engineering work.

interventions_or_exposures.description: Current EAL/2 source versus semantic-equal generic graph, with candidate explicit-negative EAL syntax nested within EAL once implemented; preserve canonical graph and fact set.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Bidirectional parse comparison and token audit; candidate grammar changes syntax only in the surface test and any changed capability is evaluated separately.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: Two common formats; nested two EAL grammar variants conditional on parity gate.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Before authoring and recipient delivery; no mid-task assignment change.
manipulation_checks: Both renderings parse to same canonical semantics
recovery_checks: Round-trip after revision retains the intended attacks

interventions_or_exposures.description: Candidate skills/eal-assessment-routing/SKILL.md application instruction versus neutral format orientation, each supplied in EAL and equal-graph variants with matched information and budget.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Recipient's procedural selection of relevant scope, method, objection and final status
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Freeze concise, reviewable skill text; include mandatory check sequence and status reporting in active version; neutral version gives syntax orientation only.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: One pinned instruction per representation and task.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Before reading the source and evidence in a fresh context.
manipulation_checks: Blinded semantic equivalence of EAL and graph checklists
off_target_checks: Additional facts or reference labels in active skill

interventions_or_exposures.description: No interpreter, trusted assessment delivered as text, or native MCP eal_assess_artifact(artifact_id) calls by a tool-capable model; host-owned final-status gate is crossed with advisory status only where assessment exists.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Allocation of graph computation and authority for final status
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Same EAL and graph methods with frozen records; native MCP condition requires assess call and logs invocation; external facilitator supplies equivalent computed report to every model class; gated output reads host report directly and never accepts a model paraphrase as the authoritative status. A required MCP call not made, a stale assessment or failed authorisation yields no host status (explicit unavailable), not a model fallback. The trusted host authenticates caller/task and verifies an approved artifact digest, registered claims/context/scope and time; artifact_id is a selector, not authorisation. For a new scope, an operator approves a new artifact/version. Compare compact status-only response and explanation-rich response at matched required detail.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: Three delivery modes and nested two final-authority modes; native MCP unavailable on endpoints lacking tool calls.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: After records are fixed, before final response; no tool access in unaided arm.
manipulation_checks: Exact assessment digest and method IDs
Host gate final status matches assessment
Wrong caller/task or unapproved artifact rejected
off_target_checks: Text-only model saw a reference answer in report
Full trace bytes dwarf compact result or one route has a warm-cache advantage
recovery_checks: Withhold/revoke adverse observation and reassess; host gate changes status accordingly

interventions_or_exposures.description: Developer A uses a pinned author model to create and revise a reusable EAL or generic graph source from an ordinary brief; isolated developer B sessions use the approved frozen artifact for N separate decisions within its registered claim, scope, context and time interval while eligible evidence changes. Sessions are independent contexts, not independent task roots or independent statistical outcomes.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Amortisation, translation fidelity and recipient error
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Cross two author-model capabilities with recipient classes; freeze author draft and equal-budget review before recipient prompts; count all author failures and review repairs. If B presents a different scope or claim, reject that artifact and open a separate approved artifact/version with its authoring/review charge.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: Ten actual fresh recipient sessions per authored source, assigned across the three evidence states 4/3/3 and across three recipient classes 4/3/3 with imbalance counterbalanced across roots; primary N=10, exploratory model-based N=1,3,30 projections. No within-root call counts as an independent root.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Author/review/revise first, then recipient sessions with no author context.
manipulation_checks: Recipient sees only frozen authored material and fresh record
No root or output labels in author context
off_target_checks: One route receives more source facts or review time
An artifact ID alone bypasses trusted task-to-artifact authorisation
recovery_checks: Apply adverse and invalidated adverse change and compare required source edits

controls.description: Generic graph receives identical typed predicates, binding, methods, attacks, defences, errors, host gate, acquisition fixture, compact and explanation-rich responses, and cache-optimised registered-artifact serving.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Calling a generic interpreter benefit EAL-specific.
controls.implementation: Canonical graph equivalence and mutation suite before calls; warm and cold cache parity plus identical status/explanation requirements; publish mismatch list.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Suspend EAL-specific contrasts if parity fails.

controls.description: Recipient receives ordinary brief and current record under equal total budget without reusable formalisation.
controls.implementation: Independently frozen prompt and equal external fact access; include author cost for prepared routes.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Report total workflow gain as a separate system contrast.

controls.description: Neutral orientation matches delivery and budget but omits apply/execute instructions.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Longer or more salient prompt falsely credited to a procedural skill.
controls.implementation: Matched fact content and placement; report token counts.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: If skills leak task answer or change facts, suspend skill attribution.

controls.description: Wrong-scope, incomplete non-detection, expired source and internally coherent but externally false synthetic source.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Copying verdict, over-closing absence and confusing binding with physical authentication.
controls.implementation: Freeze variants and check expected rejection or trust limit separately.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Accepted wrong-scope or expired record invalidates corresponding host claim; coherent false source limits physical inference.

controls.failure_mode_addressed: Class imbalance and leaked final labels.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: If candidate does not beat trivial baselines, withhold utility claim.

controls.description: Independent brief-level oracle and source-fidelity assessment precede interpreter outputs.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Correct answer to the wrong formalised problem.
controls.implementation: Double review and independent finite checker, with disputed root quarantine before randomisation.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: No end-to-end result on unresolved root.

confounds.description: Instruction and syntax alter token length, placement and provider cache behaviour.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Changes attention and billed cost alongside intended syntax or skill intervention.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Freeze exact prompts, run length-matched sensitivity pair where practical and report natural total effect separately.
confounds.diagnostic: Prompt token distribution by condition and cache hit logs.
confounds.residual_risk: Length is a mediator of deployment effects; no unique cognitive attribution.

confounds.description: Different model capacities and tool support prevent a complete orthogonal cross.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Native MCP arm is unavailable for non-tool models and model choice may drive apparent representation gain.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Predeclared within-model estimates; model class is a moderator and native-tool contrasts are nested only within tool-capable endpoints.
confounds.diagnostic: Availability probes, product snapshot and observed tool logs.
confounds.residual_risk: Cannot extrapolate native tool effects to non-tooling SLMs.

confounds.description: More expert review of one format yields cleaner source.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Source-quality advantage masquerades as language advantage.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Equal review budget, crossed author class, blinded fidelity rubric and all repair attempts retained.
confounds.diagnostic: Author/reviewer time, error taxonomy and initial draft fidelity per format.
confounds.residual_risk: Format familiarity of human reviewer remains.

estimands.population_or_system: Predeclared task-family finite population under crossed author and recipient classes.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: Developer A authors and revises EAL/2 under equal review, then developer B recipients use checked EAL artefact.
estimands.comparator: Same developer/model/reviewer allocation using an equal-capability generic graph and checker.
estimands.time: One authoring and revision episode plus ten isolated recipients with varying eligible evidence for one registered claim and scope.
estimands.summary_measure: Paired root-weighted ratio of cumulative provider-billed model tokens per correct qualified decision at ten actual recipient calls; paired false-support risk difference and end-to-end source fidelity. Report provider token totals and correct counts separately; monetary cost including reviewer labour, host and network plus latency is a distinct secondary outcome.
estimands.interpretation: Practical EAL-specific provider-token efficiency conditional on source semantics, equal host capability, one registered claim and scope; deployment requires separate total resource analysis. Token ratio has no finite value if either route never succeeds.

estimands.population_or_system: Reviewed fixed sources on new three-state roots, each pinned recipient model.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: Host-owned status from checked source and record.
estimands.comparator: Model-only interpretation of identical raw source, record and matched instruction.
estimands.summary_measure: Root-weighted exact-sequence difference and false-support risk difference within model and format.
estimands.interpretation: Whole-system execution and authority effect, not EAL-specific parser advantage or model reasoning.

estimands.population_or_system: Fixed-source unaided recipient arms within pinned class.
estimands.summary_measure: Root-weighted complete-sequence accuracy difference, false-support difference and tokens, separately by EAL/graph and model.
estimands.interpretation: Effect of assigned instruction bundle, with length as a measured part.

estimands.population_or_system: New briefs under a pinned author model and equal diagnostic budget.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: Explicit negative-finding/attack EAL syntax with unchanged canonical semantics.
estimands.comparator: Current EAL/2 syntax with the same checks.
estimands.summary_measure: Root-weighted complete-source-fidelity risk difference, omitted-attack and wrong-scope differences, with per-version token cost.
estimands.interpretation: A grammar rendering effect only after exact semantic parity and equal diagnostics; otherwise a compound language-change effect.

estimands.population_or_system: Prospectively held-out independent roots from frozen task families.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: Locked route rule selecting neutral model, skilled model, tool model, EAL host or equal graph host based on calibration features available before answer.
estimands.comparator: Better of fixed always-check and fixed always-equal-graph strategies selected without held-out data.
estimands.summary_measure: Cost per correct qualified decision subject to prespecified false-support <=0.02 absolute risk constraint, compared by root.
estimands.interpretation: Prospective routing performance; no mechanistic attribution to an assumed internal model representation.

identification.causal_and_measurement_structure: Brief -> authored source and fidelity -> host status -> recipient output; assigned format and skill can affect fidelity/attention; model class modifies all stages; source review and interpreter capability are held equal across representation routes; evidence acquisition is fixed synthetic. Potential outcomes identify effects within selected roots under session isolation, not an unrestricted engineering population.
identified_parameters: Finite-root average paired route contrast if randomized/frozen and parity gates hold
Observed N-specific cost break-even in declared pricing scenarios
nonidentified_alternatives: Native MCP effect for endpoints without native tool capability
rescue_actions: Restrict inference to observed product and roots
Run new independent cohort after amendment

sampling.method: Calibration pilot on eight new roots with all planned factorial arms, then a separately locked root-cluster power and precision simulation before fixing independent confirmatory root count. No confirmatory claim from pilot.
sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: Compact-status pilot: eight independent roots x three evidence states x two formats x two instruction states x three delivery modes x two tool-capable model snapshots = 288 fixed-source calls; one non-tool small snapshot has two eligible delivery modes and adds eight x three x two x two x two = 96 calls (Stage 1 total 384). Developer stage: eight roots x two formats x two author models x three author/revision calls = 96 calls, plus eight x two formats x two authors x ten isolated recipient sessions = 320 calls (Stage 2 total 416; complete pilot 800). Ten recipients per source are counterbalanced 4/3/3 across evidence states and 4/3/3 across recipient classes; they share root and authored artifact. Host-owned gates are deterministic and add no model call. Explanation-rich outcomes and grammar extension need separately costed amendments. Exact schedule and budget must be frozen before calls. Confirmatory independent-root n is not specified yet.
inputs: Paired discordance q, root-family intraclass correlation, source fidelity, cost variance, missing/error rates and practical thresholds from pilot
Five-percent two-sided familywise error for primary superiority plus noninferiority gate; sensitivity to costs and cache
sampling.dependence_structure: Root is independent cluster; three states, repeats, models and recipients within a root are correlated. Author output is shared by recipients and cannot count as independent replication.
sampling.multiplicity: Primary EAL versus graph cost-at-error is one hierarchical gate; all grammar, skill, model class and interactions secondary with Holm intervals or descriptive exploratory labels after gate.
sampling.attrition_or_loss: All scheduled attempts, errors, timeouts and truncated responses retained; incomplete paid calls are failures for intention-to-treat endpoint and separately tagged for cost uncertainty.
sampling.result: At n=24 independent roots and paired discordance q=0.30 with true paired difference 0.15, normal approximation SE=sqrt((0.30-0.15^2)/24)=0.108 and 95% half-width ~0.21. At q=0.30 and target 0.10 half-width, n~107 roots before family correlation. Worst-case q=1 requires ~385 independent roots. Thus 800 compact-status pilot calls on eight roots cannot confirm a modest EAL-specific advantage.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Before confirmatory freeze, simulate hierarchical paired binary and skewed cost outcomes over q in {0.2,0.3,0.6}, family ICC in {0,0.1,0.3}, true accuracy differences in {0,0.05,0.10,0.20}, cost ratio {0.7,0.8,1.0}, cache and labour ranges; require >=80% joint success of cost superiority and false-support noninferiority at chosen n under the minimal effect of interest. Report interval width where power is infeasible.
sampling.stopping_implications: Pilot stops after frozen schedule or safety/billing incident; no result-driven extension. Confirmatory n and spending cap require prospective amendment before outcome access.

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Hash briefs, oracles, prompts, source representations, method registry, model IDs, adjudication rubric and schedule. Recompute canonical semantics and billed tokens. Never selectively drop failed parser/model attempts.
analysis.exclusion_lock: Only pre-randomisation ambiguous or genealogically duplicate roots can be excluded by frozen independent adjudication; post-randomisation failures remain in assigned denominators.

models.model_or_procedure: Compute each route's cumulative provider-billed model tokens T_r(N) and exact correct-qualified count Q_r(N), report T and Q separately and T/Q where Q>0; paired root bootstrap stratified by predeclared task family for log token-per-correct ratio and false-support risk difference. A route with Q=0 has infinite tokens per correct. Separately estimate same-scope token and fully priced break-even N from fixed versus marginal cost and new-scope mix from artifact reapproval rate. Pair status-only and explanation-rich outcomes at matched requested detail; count tool calls and response bytes and compare cold and cache-optimised EAL and equal-graph hosts.

Equal capability, caching and instruction budget

models.model_or_procedure: Paired root-level differences within pinned model and eligible interface; hierarchical logistic model with root and family effects for sensitivity only. Estimate factorial interactions representation x instruction, instruction x delivery, representation x delivery and model x delivery without collapsing non-tool classes into native MCP.

Use calibration data only to fit constrained expected-cost rule: choose cheapest route whose upper predictive false-support bound is <=0.02 and whose estimated status success is adequate. Lock coefficients/thresholds, then compare with eligible fixed rules on held-out roots.

analysis.uncertainty: Root-cluster paired percentile/bootstrap or exact finite-population intervals, with family strata; report raw root values and sensitivity to interval procedure. Pilot gives descriptive intervals only.
analysis.multiplicity: Primary joint criterion fixed before confirmatory cohort. Gate secondary tests after primary; adjust secondary families via Holm or label exploratory. No pooling of exposed developmental roots.
analysis.missing_data: No silent retries. Include failed attempts in assigned endpoint outcome; preserve unknown billed cost and suspend currency analysis when total unbounded; show best/worst missing outcome bounds.
analysis.stopping_rule: Fixed pilot schedule; any secret exposure, provider identity change, unresolved oracle/parity failure or unknown billing halts new calls and preserves records. Confirmatory schedule has an independently frozen n and no outcome-triggered stopping.
robustness_checks: Remove source-fidelity failures only in explicitly labelled conditional analysis
Recompute with N=1,3,30 and cold/warm cache
Cost without and with human review
Report completed and all-attempt intention-to-treat results
software_and_versions: Pin repository commit, EAL/2 parser, registered methods, generic checker, host MCP schema, runner, scorer, provider model snapshot and prompt hashes before execution

Fully priced resources and latency are reported separately before deployment advice.

deployment_model.purpose: Predict the cheapest route satisfying an independently chosen false-support and answer-quality constraint, rather than inferring an internal language-model algorithm.
pre_outcome_features: Claim/attack route count and graph depth
Availability and precision of registered method
Evidence change frequency and proportion of new scopes
Required output: compact status or justified explanation
deployment_model.validity_chain: P(correct brief-level outcome) = P(faithful source) x P(eligible authentic input | faithful source) x P(correct method/argument assessment | prior stages) x P(correct final delivery | prior stages). This is an exact conditional chain, not an independence assumption. Each factor must be estimated or bounded on calibration tasks; an unknown factor blocks a confident route choice.
deployment_model.token_break_even: For two routes E and J under a common correct-decision requirement, T_E(N)=F_E+N m_E and T_J(N)=F_J+N m_J. If m_J>m_E, the nominal break-even is N>(F_E-F_J)/(m_J-m_E); otherwise no growing-N token advantage follows. Recompute with measured route success and quality costs, not only raw tokens.
deployment_model.scope_turnover: When claim, context, scope or interval changes, a new approved artifact/version contributes a new fixed F. Estimate the probability of such changes and report thresholds by this turnover rate; never reuse an old artifact for a new question.
deployment_model.decision: Select an eligible route only if its upper calibrated false-support bound meets the task-specific limit and its expected all-in cost is lowest. If factors are uncalibrated or outside support, use a checked authorised route with an explicit unavailable state when assessment fails.
limits: The chain can be modelled without claiming direct access to latent LLM cognition
Observed correlations of complexity with failure do not identify a specific internal mechanism
No fixed number of recipients makes EAL universally economical

response_targets.compact_status: Primary pilot: exact status plus limited scope/attack identifiers; equal graph and EAL hosts return the same required fields. Account model tokens, host calls and bytes separately.
response_targets.explanation_rich: Separately frozen extension: request rationale with source, method result, scope, adverse evidence, objection path and qualification; blinded reviewer checks correctness, completeness and unsupported additions. Pair routes at the same requested detail and include all tool-response bytes and tokens; do not treat a verbose trace as a free status result.
